title: Anchored controls
description:
Move and stretch controls when the window resizes, with anchors.

```
window 400x300 -> 600x400
OK button anchored right+bottom: (310, 260) -> (510, 360)
text box anchored left+right+top: width 380 -> 580
list anchored all four sides: grows both ways
```
hints: For x: left and right means `w += newW - oldW`; right only means `x += newW - oldW` (lesson 3.03).
Apply the results in `WM_SIZE` with `BeginDeferWindowPos` to move them all at once without flicker.
requirements: Each control has a rectangle at the original window size and anchor flags (left, top, right, bottom).
Anchored to both sides of an axis means it stretches; to one side, it keeps its distance to that side.
Compute every control's new rectangle for a new window size.
stretch: Add a minimum size so controls never overlap (`WM_GETMINMAXINFO`).
